children: S&K Aerospace got a $4.3 billion contract from the Defense Department.
The work to be performed for the Air Force involves an indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for parts and repair ordering system seven, the Pentagon said Wednesday.

It provides commercial buying services for non-standard and difficult-to-support standard items through comprehensive logistics support, parts procurement and repair services to foreign military sales customers across the Air Force, Army and Navy.
Work will be performed in Warner Robins, Ga., and is expected to be completed by Sept. 1, 2039.
The award involves foreign military sales to more than 100 partner nations.
